th = lewdness she needs to enjoy it (trust can stretch her up to 25 below). price = base fee. energy = what it costs her. desc = what the service is, in plain words; the AI prompts get "label (desc)" as {service}.

lust = base change to HER lust per client (negative = drop, positive = rises). Only being pleased (receiving services, positions) spends it; giving, kissing and massages build it, scaled by her lewdness: real rise = lust x (0.4 + lewdness/100) x (1.5 if favorite) x (0.6 if disliked) x her lustBuild fx. Drops: lust x client technique x (1.5 fav) x (0.6 disliked) x actQuality fx x her lust profile. finish = the client finishes (demon feeding; she can be left frustrated, but only by services that spend her lust). want = relative odds clients ask for it. kind: give | receive | massage | kiss (receiving services: with Sam he does the work, low Sam energy, big drop in her lust, no demon drain). A lady in the mood (lust >= lust.eager, lewdness >= balance.json svc.askMore.lewd) who didn't finish (lust-building service or left frustrated) may ask for more: she offers a heavier one from her menu (balance.json svc.askMore).

stats = optional {stat: weight} (weights sum to 1; stats are beauty, charm, charisma, refinement, wits, stamina, strength, agility): the service stat term (.15) of service quality is her weighted average of those stats; no stats (including custom services) = charm. Receiving services have none (she is not doing the work). If stamina is listed, her energy cost for it is also x (1.1 - stamina/500) (balance.json → svc.staminaEnergy).

dress = {min: dressed|partial|under|nude, fullAt: lewdness she needs before images show her fully undressed}. Services whose min is 'dressed' (kissing, massage) stay dressed until her lewdness reaches fullAt. Older entries with minCloth still work (read as dress.min).

image.client / image.sam / image.duo / image.fem / image.futa = pose and framing for client scenes, Sam's first-person scenes, scenes with two ladies and Sam, and scenes with two women together (fem = two women; futa = the other woman is a futanari, the active one). Each is a list: one is picked at random per image. image.extra is added to every image of this service. Anything starting with TODO is skipped when prompts are built. Every service now has default wording; the receiving ones are written softly, so make them as explicit as you like.
report = lines for the weekly report when a client got this service (one is picked at random; empty falls back to flavor.json client_yes).

tier: how far past the line it is with Sam (1 kissing & touching, 2 hands & mouth, 3 everything). Private time with Sam only offers services up to the tier she's crossed in her firsts (data/firsts.json). Custom services without a tier count as 1 below line 30, 2 below 50, else 3.

Naming: services that go both ways come in pairs, _give (she does it to him) and _get (he does it to her), labelled "X (giving)" / "X (receiving)". Positions (missionary, cowgirl, doggy) and kiss are single. Old ids still work as aliases in code: caress -> kiss, manual -> manual_give, oral -> oral_give, paizuri -> breast_give.
Scales: th and dress.fullAt are LEWDNESS thresholds, and lewdness stays 0-100 (like trust, mood and lust). Only stats, tech and service skills run 0-1000, so a two-digit th here is correct.
energyBack / mood (optional): energy she regains and mood she gains from a service (massage_get).
tiredAt (optional): energy fraction (0-1, e.g. 0.45) below which a tired lady prefers not to perform this strenuous service.

ask = how the weekly report phrases it. client: what he asks for, after "asked" ("asked for oral", "asked to go down on her"). lady: what SHE does when she's the one offering, after "she" ("she offered to go down on him"). Custom services without ask fall back to their label.
